allowedClaims: LocalRuntimeOS source-present owner inventory can be reported when architecture_inventory passes.
LocalRuntimeProof Gate Green means the current 20-item LRO-100 checklist is semantic, fail-closed, and passing for the checked source tree.
For the current checked source tree and the represented 20-item checklist, no known meaningful Ambitions state-change bypass remains outside Command -> Event -> Projection -> Receipt -> Replay.
blockedClaims: LocalRuntimeOS is complete across future or unscanned code paths
physical-device behavior, rendered UI quality, accessibility conformance, privacy/legal approval, Visual Green, Release Green, TestFlight readiness, or App Store readiness
production CloudKit continuity or production R2 deployment

checklist.requirement: Final architecture inventory must be green before LocalRuntimeProof can claim runtime law coverage.
checklist.summary: Final architecture tree source parity is green.
checklist.title: Final Architecture Tree source parity

checklist.requirement: All 19 LocalRuntimeOS owners must exist with production Swift source.
checklist.summary: All 19 LocalRuntimeOS owners are source-present.
checklist.title: LocalRuntimeOS owner coverage

checklist.requirement: Command, event, projection, replay, search, and outbox integration points must be source-present.
checklist.summary: Core command, event, projection, replay, search, and outbox integration markers are present.
checklist.title: Core runtime integration evidence

checklist.requirement: Production runtime event authority must be SQLite and must not fall back to JSONL authority.
checklist.summary: Production runtime event authority is SQLite; JSONL authority is not selected by AppContainerFactory.
checklist.title: Live event-store authority

checklist.requirement: Command journal records, RuntimeEvents, receipts, replay, diagnostics, and RuntimeDoctor drift signals must reconcile.
checklist.summary: Command journal/runtime event linkage and drift diagnostics are present.
checklist.title: Command journal to RuntimeEvent reconciliation

checklist.requirement: Meaningful successful mutations must require transaction, event, projection, receipt, rollback, and replay evidence.
checklist.summary: Meaningful successful mutations require runtime transaction, event, receipt, rollback, and replay evidence or fail closed.
checklist.title: Fail-closed meaningful mutation commit

checklist.requirement: Runtime event append and mutation projection materialization must be owned by the transaction coordinator or approved rebuild path.
checklist.summary: Runtime event append and projection materialization ownership is restricted to the coordinator and approved rebuild path.
checklist.title: RuntimeTransactionCoordinator ownership

checklist.requirement: Today, Goals, Time, You, Search, and rebuild paths must consume ProjectionStore/SearchStore evidence rather than raw private graph reads.
checklist.summary: ProjectionStore/SearchStore surface read adapter and command-commit projection persistence markers are present.
checklist.title: ProjectionStore/SearchStore consumption

checklist.requirement: Widgets, App Intents, notifications, and share surfaces must use sanitized projections or durable intake records.
checklist.summary: Widget/runtime readers use safe AppGroup snapshot records; writer consumes sanitized projections; App Intents/share use sanitized or durable-intake bridges.
checklist.title: Sanitized external-surface reads

checklist.requirement: PrivacySecurity must gate egress, export, diagnostics, external snapshots, App Intent/share bridges, and file protection.
checklist.summary: PrivacySecurity gates egress, export, diagnostics, external snapshots, App Intent/share bridges, and file protection.
checklist.title: PrivacySecurity external boundary

checklist.requirement: Source Atlas/R2 request and cache paths must remain public-reference-only and deny private graph payloads.
checklist.summary: SourceAtlas/R2 request, gateway, endpoint, manifest/cache/LKG, and projection paths are gated as public-reference-only.
checklist.title: Source Atlas/R2 public-only boundary

checklist.requirement: SyncContinuity must not become backend authority and must preserve local runtime/projection authority.
checklist.summary: SyncContinuity gates transport eligibility by runtime/projection source, privacy class, local authority, conflict review, and account cleanup non-authority.
checklist.title: SyncContinuity non-authority

checklist.requirement: Capture accepted input must be durably journaled before classification, attachment staging, promotion, and restart lookup.
checklist.summary: Capture accepted input is journaled before classification, attachment staging, promotion, and restart lookup evidence.
checklist.title: Capture durable intake before promotion

checklist.requirement: External side effects must require prior local runtime commit receipt evidence.
checklist.summary: External side effects require local runtime commit receipt evidence before attempt.
checklist.title: Side-effect local commit receipt gating

checklist.requirement: Inspection receipt, proof, undo, audit, source, and history records must carry runtime commit receipt lineage.
checklist.summary: Inspection receipt, proof, undo, audit, source, and history records require runtime commit receipt lineage.
checklist.title: Inspection runtime lineage

checklist.requirement: Canonical object-state writes must require coordinator-issued RuntimeMutationContext.
checklist.summary: Canonical object-state write repositories require coordinator-issued Transactions RuntimeMutationContext.
checklist.title: RuntimeMutationContext boundaries

checklist.requirement: RuntimeDoctor must detect local drift with redacted readers and produce receipt-backed reviewable repair previews.
checklist.summary: RuntimeDoctor has redacted local drift readers, receipt-backed preview repair plans, and focused tests.
checklist.title: RuntimeDoctor local drift repair previews

checklist.requirement: Production surface/app/interaction/extension code must not contain high-risk direct mutation or external-write bypasses.
checklist.summary: No high-risk mutation or external-write bypass candidates were found.
checklist.title: High-risk mutation bypass scan

checklist.requirement: Feature/service repository writes must be command-owned, transaction-owned, migration-owned, test-only, or non-canonical.
checklist.summary: Feature/service repository writes are classified as command-owned, transaction-owned, test-only, migration-owned, or explicitly non-canonical.
checklist.title: Feature/service write authority classification

checklist.requirement: Known Issues/truth files must reflect the proof ceiling, stale runtime-source blockers must be absent, and CI must run LocalRuntimeProof.
checklist.summary: Known Issues, truth files, and CI workflow evidence preserve the LocalRuntimeOS proof ceiling.
checklist.title: Known Issues, truth, and CI evidence
